title: sig_verify.rs: module doc references SmimeError::Io (renamed to Other)
description: sig_verify.rs module-level comment (line 5) says 'error-constructor closure so the caller can map failures to the appropriate SmimeError variant (CertChain or Io).' SmimeError::Io was renamed to SmimeError::Other. Stale doc will confuse future contributors looking for the Io variant.
